card.name: Word endings in rare or foreign words
card.fires_on: Partway through or at the end of a split word, often a foreign name, a language name, or a word broken before its ending (Latv|ian, grünbe|rk, de|posed, den|iers).

modes.label: Foreign or name pieces
modes.description: The piece falls inside a foreign name or language term in a linguistic or biographical setting.
modes.example: Umbrian pelsatu 'to overcome, conquer', Latin pellere ("to drive, beat"), Latv<<ian>> lijuôs, plīti

modes.label: Split prefix pieces
modes.description: The piece is the start of a longer word such as de- or den- that begins a verb or noun.
modes.example: If neo-Nazis and Nazi holocaust<< den>>iers can be prosecuted in Germany, France

modes.label: Short linking words
modes.description: A short function word like as, has or 's after a noun, in plain running text.
modes.example: soon<< as>> possible and then resume usual dosing schedule

card.plain: It fires on odd word pieces, mostly in foreign or rare words, where the model is mid-word and must finish it.
evidence: Nazi holocaust<< den>>iers can be prosecuted
